caption: A surfer falls off their board, colliding briefly with another surfer, before swimming away.
positive_analysis:
If the bright-topped surfer loses balance, their body separates from the board and drops into the breaking water.
A falling surfer's trajectory may briefly intersect the nearby dark-topped surfer, causing a momentary contact.
After the brief collision, the fallen surfer pushes away and swims clear of both boards and the other rider.
The remaining surfer continues riding the white wave crest while the fallen one drifts toward calmer water.
